original_local_hypothesis.GPU_profile: actual batchK-dependent forward and training times, event timing and peak allocator memory; fixed widths/parameter counts do not assert equal compute
original_local_hypothesis.control: Common multihead preLN attention block, common eight-role readout, same TRAIN identities/update counts/paired seeds; change token ownership and typed routing only.
original_local_hypothesis.experiment: Action-conditioned sparse occupied-piece tokens plus eight typed threat/plan tokens versus64 dense square tokens.
original_local_hypothesis.material_prior: same positive TRAIN-only physical material scale and true-action algebraic prior
original_local_hypothesis.quality: separate sealed joint scalar/root validation gate with NONE, no new heldout peeks
original_local_hypothesis.simulator: exact legality/history/terminal classification remains external to learned latents

sources.finding: Square tokens; compressed global board representation generates head-specific additive attention biases. Separate attention source-destination policy head. Its positional bias is dynamically generated rather than six static geometry indicators plus one pseudoattack coefficient.
sources.inference: A controlled dynamic or typed bias ablation is plausible, but published large-data strength does not predict the strength of this small corpus or establish Lichess rating.
sources.local_relation: Our relation backend has single-head square self-attention with learned coefficients on fixed geometry and pseudoattack edges. Our plan backend adds eight plan-token cross-attention and returns square slots before the independent eight-role bottleneck. Neither is a reproduced Chessformer.
sources.title: Chessformer: A Unified Architecture for Chess Modeling

sources.finding: External MCTS and internally generated linearized minimax trees are separate mechanisms. Internal search is trained with serialized tree traces; its input specifies breadth/depth. Authors separately report internal/external rating calibration.
sources.inference: Any future latent-search claim needs a separately admitted multi-ply curriculum and explicit refresh policy, not a relabeling of one-step prediction.
sources.local_relation: Our one-step transported role latents plus exact simulator sidecars are neither a serialized internal search tree nor wholly learned game rules. Sparse observations are insufficient contiguous rollout training data.
sources.title: Mastering Board Games by External and Internal Planning with Language Models

sources.finding: The paper separates legal-move accuracy, Stockfish topK move quality and variant/game evaluation. Promotion-derived excess-piece positions and same-color bishops test compositional generalization.
sources.inference: A later OOD probe should test value/order behavior under promotions and rare material patterns; Chess960 requires an actual rules extension and separate admission.
sources.local_relation: Our simulator legal masks already certify action legality, so neural legal accuracy would be tautological. Scalar intervals, complete-root choice and actual playing strength must remain separate evidence.
sources.title: Out-of-distribution Tests Reveal Compositionality in Chess Transformers
